title: Can a city require a permit for prayer at home? Supreme Court will decide
summary: A U.S. Supreme Court case originating from a Cleveland suburb dispute over home prayer gathering permits is set to reshape how religious organizations challenge local zoning laws and permitting requirements nationwide. The case involves resident Daniel Grand's years-long legal battle with University Heights city officials regarding permission to host religious gatherings in his home. This decision could have significant implications for how municipalities enforce zoning and permitting regulations.
